text: Originate ACH transfers via a POST /ach_transfers API call
quote: You make a `POST /ach_transfers` call with the details of how much you'd like to send and data about the recipient.

text: Send domestic wire transfers via a POST /wire_transfers API call
quote: You make a `POST /wire_transfers` call with the details of how much you'd like to send and data about the recipient.

text: Send Real-Time Payments (RTP) any time of day with instant settlement
quote: Real-Time Payments can be sent at any time during the day and funds will settle instantly.

text: Issue physical checks programmatically; Increase prints, mails, and tracks them through deposit/return
quote: Check Transfers let you send a physical check without operating a printer or a mailroom. Increase prints and mails the check on your behalf, holds the funds until it's deposited, and tracks it through mailing, deposit, and any returns.

text: Webhooks notify your application of transaction events so you can trigger actions like user alerts
quote: Increase can reach out to your application so that you can take action (such as sending an email alert about the transaction to your user) automatically.

text: Full sandbox parity with production API/dashboard, plus special Simulation APIs only in sandbox
quote: Every API and dashboard feature is available in Sandbox. ... you can use special Simulation APIs, which are only available in Sandbox.

text: Instantly create and manage multiple account numbers for a single account programmatically
quote: You can instantly create multiple Account Numbers for a single Account and manage them programmatically.

text: Optionally require approval from another team member before a transfer executes
quote: Optionally, transfers can be held for approval by another team member.

text: Routing Numbers API lets you confirm whether an institution supports Real-Time Payments
quote: You can use the Routing Numbers API to confirm whether an institution supports Real-Time Payments.

text: Issue each investor/customer a unique account number for automatic reconciliation across Wire, RTP, ACH, or Check funds
quote: With Increase, you can issue each investor a unique Account Number. This allows for automatic reconciliation of any received funds from that investor, regardless of how they send funds (via Wire, RTP, ACH, or even Check).

text: Send FedNow transfers, checking reachability via Routing Number endpoint and falling back to ACH or wire
quote: Sending FedNow transfers covers how to check reachability with the Routing Number endpoint and fall back to ACH or a wire.

text: Entity validation results are exposed via the API for each data version, flagging data issues to follow up on
quote: Increase makes Entity validations available via the API for each version of the data. You should follow up with your customer when the validation indicates a data issue.

text: Access multi-million-dollar FDIC insurance through participating IntraFi network banks directly in Increase
quote: Access multi-million-dollar FDIC insurance at participating IntraFi network banks directly in Increase.

text: Place holds on an account to reserve funds for known future activity without moving money
quote: Increase lets you place a hold on an Account to reserve funds for known future activity. Holds reduce the available balance without moving money, and can be released when they're no longer needed.

text: Real-time card authorization decisions are exposed as an API object with a real-time webhook for you to approve/decline
quote: When a user tries to use their card and Increase has to decide to approve the authorization or not... we'll create a Real-Time Decision object in the API and send you a special real-time webhook.
